DraftSight

DraftSight focuses on professional DWG drafting, annotation and drawing-management workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Clean a legacy drawing

Use the controlled drawing, units and reference files. In the intended DraftSight preview, clean a legacy drawing; the visible result is revised linework with the changed dimensions called out. Review scale, geometry and drawing standard before accepting or exporting it.

Standardise annotations

Start from the agreed layer, block and reference structure. In the intended DraftSight preview, standardise annotations; the visible result is a coordinated sheet view with conflicts exposed. Review layer ownership, reference paths and annotation legibility before accepting or exporting it.

Compare and issue a revision

Begin with the checked model-space and sheet-space views. In the intended DraftSight preview, compare and issue a revision; the visible result is a revision-ready drawing package with its change set visible. Review title data, issue scope and plotted output before accepting or exporting it.
